title: Sandustry Demo Guide — What to Test Before Buying
description: Sandustry Steam demo checklist: performance, core loop, and how the free demo differs from Early Access.

paragraphs: The free Sandustry Demo is on Steam as a separate app (3490390). Reviews on the demo page have been Very Positive.
Use it to validate FPS, controls, and whether the dig–refine–automate fantasy clicks for you.
Dig and reshape terrain until physics feel readable.
Complete the early refine / gold-oriented intro loop.
Place at least one conveyor or logistics building and watch material flow.
Stress your PC with a denser dig and more buildings — factory games spike CPU/GPU late.
Skim Discord or Reddit after playing to see current EA complaints versus demo limits.
Expect the full EA build (app 2764460) to go deeper on buildings, resources, production chains, quests, and technologies — Steam's EA notes describe roughly a year of planned content.
The demo is a taste, not a complete substitute. Wishlist or buy only after the loop feels good.

faq.a: Treat demo and full game as separate unless Steam or the developer explicitly says otherwise in patch notes. Check the demo and main store pages before assuming cloud saves migrate.
